excerpts.text: **SpaceX Crew-11** was the eleventh operational NASA [Commercial Crew Program](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commercial_Crew_Program "Commercial Crew Program") flight and the 19th crewed orbital flight of a [Crew Dragon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crew_Dragon "Crew Dragon") spacecraft. The mission transported four crew members, [NASA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NASA "NASA") astronauts [Zena Cardman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zena_Cardman "Zena Cardman") and [Michael Fincke](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Fincke "Michael Fincke"), [JAXA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JAXA "JAXA") astronaut [Kimiya Yui](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimiya_Yui "Kimiya Yui"), and [Roscosmos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roscosmos "Roscosmos") cosmonaut [Oleg Platonov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oleg_Platonov_(cosmonaut) "Oleg Platonov (cosmonaut)"), to the [International Space Station](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Space_Station "International Space Station") (ISS). The mission launched on August 1, 2025 and docked with the ISS the next day. On January 8, 2026, NASA announced that the mission would end about a month earlier than planned due to a medical situation involving Fincke.

In the front from left are, Crew-11 members Oleg Platonov, Mike Fincke, Zena Cardman, and Kimiya Yui. In the back are, Expedition 73 members Takuya Onishi, Kirill Peskov, Alexey Zubritsky, Sergey Ryzhikov, Jonny Kim, Nichole Ayers, and Anne McClain.](https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/blog-exp73-11-member-crew-080425.jpg?w=2048)

[Expedition 73](https://www.nasa.gov/mission/expedition-73/) expanded to eleven individuals on Saturday when [NASA’s SpaceX Crew-11](https://www.nasa.gov/mission/nasas-spacex-crew-11/) mission [docked](https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/2025/08/02/crew-11-docks-to-station-aboard-spacex-dragon/) to the orbital outpost aboard the Dragon spacecraft after [launching](https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/2025/08/01/nasas-spacex-crew-11-launches-to-international-space-station/) from Florida about 15 hours earlier.

excerpts.text: On March 27, 2025, Cardman was announced as the commander of the [SpaceX Crew-11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SpaceX_Crew-11 "SpaceX Crew-11") mission that launched on August 1, 2025.

This event necessitated the early return of Crew-11, the first "controlled medical evacuation" of the International Space Station.[[13]](#cite_note-13) Alongside crewmates [Kimiya Yui](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimiya_Yui "Kimiya Yui") and [Christopher Williams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christopher_Williams_(astronaut) "Christopher Williams (astronaut)"), Cardman received NASA's Exceptional Bravery Medal[[14]](#cite_note-14) for "exceptional courage, leadership, and composure that directly contributed to the preservation of a crewmember's life".[[15]](#cite_note-15) After 167 days in space, Cardman brought Crew-11 and their Dragon spacecraft home. They safely splashed down on January 15, 2026.[[16]](#cite_note-:2-16)
